Fact: you used your reaction on the last turn of round 1, and in round 2 the enemy leaves your reach before your turn. Your next turn has not started yet, so your reaction has not come back. Conclusion: you cannot make the opportunity attack.

The conclusion turns on how long a reaction stays spent. The Ready entry says instead that 'you can take only one reaction per round.' Read that way, round 2 is a new round, you have not used a reaction in it, and you could make the attack. The two entries give opposite verdicts here.
